parts.name: Translation Panel (Left Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left sliding panel of the window, made of glass with an aluminum frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open or close by sliding horizontally along the track, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the base frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel (Right Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right sliding panel of the window, made of glass with an aluminum frame.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the second movable section of the window, sliding horizontally to open or close the opposite side.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally in the opposite direction of the left panel within the same track.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing structural support for the sliding panels.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sliding panels in place, ensuring smooth movement and sealing when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides the track for the sliding panels.
